subtitle: Understanding how song introductions establish key centers, mood, and musical themes

introduction.title: The Role of Song Intros
introduction.text: A song's introduction is like the opening line of a great novel—it sets the stage for everything that follows. Musically, intros serve several critical functions that we can analyze and understand through music theory.

cards.title: Establish Key Center
cards.description: The intro tells your ear what key the song is in, creating a harmonic reference point that all other sections will relate to.
items: Start and end on the tonic chord
Feature the root note prominently in bass
Play a melody that outlines the tonic chord

cards.title: Set the Mood
cards.description: Intros establish the emotional tone through tempo, dynamics, harmonic color, and instrumental texture.

cards.title: Introduce Themes
cards.description: Many intros preview melodic or rhythmic motifs that will appear throughout the song, creating musical coherence.

cards.title: Create Energy
cards.description: Intros build anticipation and energy that leads naturally into the first verse, creating forward momentum.

cards.title: Instrumental Hook
cards.description: Features a memorable riff or melody that becomes the song's signature. Often uses the main chord progression or a variation of it.

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Establishes D as tonic through repeated resolution

cards.title: Atmospheric Build
cards.description: Starts quietly and gradually builds layers, dynamics, and complexity to create anticipation for the verse entrance.

fields.label: Texture
fields.value: Starts with organ, adds drums, bass, guitar

cards.title: Vocal Preview
cards.description: Features a snippet of vocal melody, often the chorus hook, before launching into the verse structure.

fields.label: Strategy
fields.value: Gives away the best part first

cards.title: Harmonic Analysis
items: Map the chord progression using Roman numerals
Note any non-diatonic chords or modulations

cards.title: Melodic & Rhythmic Analysis
items: Analyze scale choices and melodic intervals
Examine rhythmic patterns and time signature
Note how melody relates to underlying harmony

practiceSection.title: Practice Exercise
items: Choose three songs from different genres and analyze their intros using the framework above.
Listen to the intro 5-10 times to internalize the sound.
Identify the key and chord progression.
Note what mood and energy the intro creates.
Compare how different genres approach intro construction.
This exercise will train your ear to hear intros as sophisticated musical constructions rather than just "the part before the song starts."
